execution_authority.mutation_isolation: deep-copy the nominal case records independently for every mutant and every run; no mutant output is an input to another mutant

preflight.action: SHA-256 every frozen input as raw bytes
preflight.fail: INPUT_HASH_MISMATCH; do not execute or seal

preflight.action: assert contract.schema_version, step, revision, manifest path, and manifest SHA-256
preflight.pass: tekt-observable-contract-v2, P1301, 2, and exact manifest identity

preflight.action: compare contract.mutants and mutants.mutants by id without accepting additions, omissions, duplicates, or renames
preflight.pass: exact ordered ids M01 through M12 and count 12

preflight.action: for every id assert mutants.kill_cases is byte-for-byte equal to contract.mutants[witness_cases], interpreting normal_vs_inverted_vector as the one cross-order witness token
assert mutants.execution_orders.normal and .inverted are byte-for-byte equal to the corresponding contract arrays, and inverted equals reverse(normal)
preflight.pass: both arrays contain each of the 23 logical case ids exactly once and inverted is the exact reverse

preflight.action: reject any operation that reads or writes outside case metadata, classification, reason_code, selected_diagnostic_index, or the six common envelope fields
preflight.pass: all operations are within the declared application model; raw_stderr is never rewritten or compared cross-renderer

preflight.action: collect every mutants[].transformation.operations[].op and require it to be a key of mutants.application_model.operation_semantics
preflight.pass: all 12 mutants use only append, carry_previous_span, promote_unknown, replace, replace_from_case_parameter, or replace_template; unsupported count is zero

nominal_corpus_construction.required_bilateral_and_sentinel: For candidate_mode bilateral_exact or candidate_exact_sentinel, build a case record with the contract id/profile, classification Preserved, null reason_code, and envelope equal to expected in exact comparison-field order.
nominal_corpus_construction.declared_opaque: For candidate_mode bilateral_declared_opaque, build a case record with classification Unknown, expected.reason_code, null envelope, and declared_diagnostic_count 2.
nominal_corpus_construction.reference_only: Keep V20 in the execution-order stream for order preservation, but mark it non-executable and exclude it from candidate mutation, candidate classification, mutation-score evidence, and canonical candidate vectors.
nominal_corpus_construction.prohibition: Do not infer, repair, translate, or normalize any expected value. Do not obtain values from candidate code, Rust tests, or private oracle output.

mutation_interpreter.determinism: selectors resolve only named case_ids/case_groups; templates resolve only exact case_parameters; operations apply left-to-right; maps and arrays retain source order
mutation_interpreter.exactness: replace requires an exact old value; replace_template requires all referenced case parameters and an output different from the old value; replace_from_case_parameter requires the named parameter for every selected case and an exact JSON value different from the old value; any failed assertion invalidates the mutant
mutation_interpreter.state: only M12 may allocate mutable interpreter state; it is local to one order run and reset before every run
mutation_interpreter.opaque_rule: M11 operates on the case classification, not raw stderr; selected_diagnostic_index=0 documents the forbidden first-diagnostic choice without manufacturing a common envelope
mutation_interpreter.error_policy: parse errors, missing pointers, missing template parameters, invalid selectors, precondition failures, and no-op transforms are INVALID_MUTANT, never kills

run_matrix.parallelism: allowed only across isolated mutant/order/repetition tuples; preserve sequence within each order
run_matrix.raw_stderr: not used because discrimination is against contract-derived common records; any later binary execution records raw stderr separately under the contract

run_algorithm.action: Execute every preflight gate in order and stop on first failure.
Construct one immutable nominal corpus from the frozen contract and verify every executable positive is Preserved and both opaque controls are Unknown with UNSUPPORTED_DIAGNOSTIC_CARDINALITY.
Run the unmutated corpus twice in normal and twice in inverted order. After excluding V20 and sorting records by case_id, canonical vectors must be byte-identical across repetitions and orders.

For each mutant id in run_matrix order, deep-copy the nominal corpus, verify its precondition, apply its transformation in the currently selected execution order, and verify its non_equivalence_validation before classification.

Classify every executable required case by exact comparison of exit_code, stdout, diagnostic_class, message, ordered_hints, and span_bytes. Required-case Unknown is FAIL. For opaque cases, only Unknown with the declared reason is accepted; Preserved or Violated is FAIL.

A non-stateful mutant is KILLED only if every declared kill_case is rejected with the expected field witness in both orders and both repetitions. M12 is KILLED only if normal and inverted sorted canonical vector hashes differ in both repetitions and the boundary witnesses match.
Compare repetition 1 and 2 byte-for-byte for each mutant/order. Any nondeterminism beyond M12's intentional cross-order divergence is FAIL.

Compute mutation_score as killed valid mutants divided by valid mutants. Seal only at 12/12, score 1.0, zero survivors, zero invalid mutants, zero baseline regressions, and all preflight/order/repetition gates passing.
